title: Unit Event — On Your Feet — Episode5 Will Things Be Okay?

meta.Event Outline: After learning the truth behind RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD are more determined than ever to surpass that legendary night. The group decide to do what they can for the time being, but Kohane's thoughts linger on her former mentor Taiga.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm glad Soma let us know what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To think that Tono may never return to this city...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
All we can do is try to get better...
But we don't have any good ideas for how to do that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I know...
I feel like we're at a dead end.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But all we can do now is try even harder...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just try and try...
And believe that our hard work will eventually be rewarded...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're definitely in a tough pickle...
Even just today, we've been through a lot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, what if we stopped somewhere to take a break? Something sweet might help take our mind off things.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: None of you look very happy...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You just went to visit Soma at the hospital, right? What did you all talk about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, um... We talked about Arata.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
It's unfortunate to hear that he's left the city.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it's sad since we all thought your greater group was doing so well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I agree with KAITO...
I thought we had a good thing going with Tono and the others...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We all worked so hard...
And our third event ended up becoming a big success.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really thought we could surpass RAD WEEKEND with them by our side.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I couldn't do anything that time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My legs collapsed under me. I felt so powerless...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That time...
If only I hadn't given up...
If only I sang with everything I had...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We might've been able to get the others to stay. Even just one of them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Taiga's someone who performs all around the world... It only makes sense that he was able to defeat us so easily...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I can't help but feel...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really frustrated.
If only I did something different that time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: At the same time, I know there's no use crying over spilled milk...
